name: Watanabe Kazuki
source:
"That's wrong!"

An ordinary student at Hope's Peak Academy who has no special talents. The reason why he entered Hope's Peak Academy was that he won a lottery for ordinary high school students.

He was the only lucky boy who was lucky enough to be selected. He finds it easy to get along with others because he is tolerant, but sometimes shows an insensitive side.
